all_candidates.topic: Will export duty cuts lower domestic fuel prices?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government cut windfall gains tax on exports of petrol to zero, and reduced duties on diesel and ATF, effective August 15, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Will free online coaching reduce exam stress?
all_candidates.news_anchor: PM Modi announced free online coaching for competitive examinations on August 15, 2026, to ease financial burden.

all_candidates.topic: Should India ban social media for minors?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A private member's Bill, the 'Shield Bill, 2025', listed on August 7, 2026, proposes social media bans for under 13/16 year olds.

all_candidates.topic: Are consumer product price hikes justified now?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India's consumer companies are preparing for another round of price hikes on everyday products due to surging commodity prices, mentioned on August 1, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should government intervene on rising food prices?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A Reuters poll (August 7, 2026) indicated Indian July consumer inflation likely edged higher on food prices.

all_candidates.topic: Should restaurants be banned from service charge?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India's Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) initiated action against 41 restaurants for levying service charges, fining Chaayos (July 19, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Is current UPI charges policy sustainable?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Ministry of Finance clarified on August 8, 2026, that UPI users will continue to make payments without transaction charges for personal use.

all_candidates.topic: Is UPI bill an unfair burden for merchants?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026, passed by Lok Sabha on August 6, 2026, empowers the government to allow charges on UPI transactions.

all_candidates.topic: Should Delhi ban new petrol two-wheelers?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Delhi Cabinet approved a new EV Policy 2026 on August 6, 2026, with a goal of no petrol two-wheeler registrations from August 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Are AI workers safe from AI-driven layoffs?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A survey published August 9-10, 2026, found 66% of India's AI and ML workers expect layoffs within 3-6 months.

all_candidates.topic: Should JPSC reforms include external oversight?
all_candidates.news_anchor: All three members of the Jharkhand Public Service Commission (JPSC) resigned on August 9, 2026, amid massive protests over alleged irregularities in recruitment tests.

all_candidates.topic: Does UPI number masking enhance privacy?
all_candidates.news_anchor: NPCI directed apps to mask mobile numbers, with only the last 4 digits visible, with a September 4, 2026 deadline.

all_candidates.topic: Are new credit card fees fair for users?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Banks and credit card issuers are revamping fee structures and reward schemes from August 1, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should consumers have absolute "right to know"?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Supreme Court granted six weeks (from August 5, 2026) for states to respond to a plea seeking consumers' "right to know" about product quality and certification.

all_candidates.topic: Should India prioritize E20 rollout speed?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government announced plans on August 10, 2026, to accelerate the rollout of E20 petrol across more cities by the end of the year.

all_candidates.topic: Will new CKYC 2.0 simplify banking for all?
all_candidates.news_anchor: CKYC 2.0, a new unified KYC system, launched on August 1, 2026, to eliminate repeated document submissions.

all_candidates.topic: Should RBI regulate bank loan interest spreads?
all_candidates.news_anchor: RBI issued new guidelines on August 12, 2026, proposing to standardize interest-rate setting across banks, requiring lenders to maintain spreads for three years.

all_candidates.topic: Will new MSME bill boost small businesses?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development (Amendment) Bill, 2026, was passed by Parliament in August 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Is hydrogen fuel best for Indian railways?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Indian Railways launched its first indigenously developed Hydrogen Fuel Cell Trainset in July 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Is foreign assets disclosure scheme effective?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government opened a one-time window starting August 16, 2026, for small taxpayers to disclose undisclosed foreign assets.
